description: Land Title Settlement Department - Waradala, Divulapitiya D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510001
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, including specific determinations of land ownership, parcel numbers, extents, and ownership details for multiple land parcels. It contains detailed schedules with land ownership information, property boundaries, and legal determinations regarding land titles, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
